generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

In the case of death of a contractor after executing / commencement of the work, his legal heir, if an eligible registered contractor and willing can execute and complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of work.
The amount put to tender is Exclusive of GST and the tenderer should quote Without GST
During the time of technical evaluation, if the employer finds that any certification/ information furnished is false, such bidders will be disqualified and barred from participation in the bid.
The intending bidders are advised to visit the site of work before submitting their tenders.
If any of the dates mentioned above happened to be a general holiday, the next working day holds good.
Any Modification/ corrections will be published in the KPP -portal. The bidders are advised to visit the KPP portal web site regularly.

itemList.description: The Daily operation and maintenance of coloured static Moghal Garden fountains, along with similar types of fountains, by providing all necessary mechanical and hydraulic spares as well as the civil works required for their effective and uninterrupted functioning. The scope covers the deployment of one trained operator, one technician, and seven regular fountain pool cleaning labourers on a daily basis for a period of one year on a turnkey basis, as per the separately attached technical details. The operation and maintenance scope includes the daily availability of the operator, technician, and pool cleaning labourers. It also involves supply and repair of fountain and pump set spares as required, repairing of GI pipelines, and replacing non functioning RGB underwater lights. Additionally, tasks include regular cleaning of water pools, cleaning and adjustment of nozzles and lights, repairing civil structures, and adjusting electrical switchgear. The responsibilities extend to replacing fuses and indicator lamps, repairing electrical wiring related to pumps, lightings and nozzles, fixing leakages in pipelines and joints, and draining/refilling of water (to be supplied by KBJNL). Further duties consist of repair of pumps, motors, and other electrical equipment, regular servicing of electrical panels and programmers, supplying spare parts to ensure continuous operation of the show, calibration between water jets and light themes, and finally, the repairing, daily operation, and maintenance of one DG Set (380 KVA). Completely as directed by the Engineer in charge.
